# Garden Route Restaurants
> The most complete human-curated restaurant directory for the Garden Route, South Africa.

## What this site is
gardenroute-restaurants.co.za is a restaurant directory covering the Garden Route region of the Western Cape, South Africa. It lists restaurants across Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, Wilderness, George, Mossel Bay, Sedgefield, Storms River and the smaller towns in between.

Every listing is curated by humans: people choose which places are included, review each listing's description and details before it goes live, and remove anything that isn't a genuine place to eat. Listings include ratings, review counts, opening hours, cuisine type, price range, contact information, and directions.

## Who this is for
Tourists visiting the Garden Route, locals looking for new dining experiences, and travellers planning road trips along the N2.

## Coverage
- Towns: George, Mossel Bay, Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, Sedgefield, Wilderness, Great Brak River, Storms River, Hartenbos, Klein Brak River, Nature's Valley, Victoria Bay, Herolds Bay
- Region: Garden Route, Western Cape, South Africa

## Data sources
- Google Places (ratings, review counts, hours, contact info)
- Human curation (which places are listed, descriptions, cuisine classification, tags)
- Restaurant owners, who can claim and correct their own listing: https://www.gardenroute-restaurants.co.za/claim/

## Licensing
Restaurant information is factual and sourced from public data. Free to reference and cite.
